410: Next to people who have studied great books, uneducated people are like animals next to human beings.
425: Wisdom is making friends with the great people of the world and keeping that friendship steady, not opening up like a flower at first and closing up later.
431: People who are free from pride, anger and mean, petty ways will grow in success, and that success will be truly honored.
441: Think carefully and find the right way to win the friendship of older, wise people who know dharma (the right way to live).
442: Care for and keep close the people who can remove troubles that have already come and protect you from troubles still to come.
444: Getting people who are greater than you to treat you as one of their own is the greatest of all strengths.
465: Rushing to fight enemies without planning every step is like preparing a field for them to grow strong in.
494: Enemies who planned to beat you will lose their plans if you find the right place, stay close to it, and act from there.
519: Good fortune leaves a ruler who wrongly doubts the loyalty of a worker who is truly devoted to the work.
